levels.title: EXPLORE CEFR LANGUAGE LEVELS
levels.subtitle: From your very first greeting in Zagreb to fluent business discussions in Split.

a1.title: A1 · BEGINNER
a1.desc: Master basic greetings, present tense (biti, imati), numbers, and daily survival phrases for moving to Croatia.

a2.title: A2 · ELEMENTARY
a2.desc: Order at cafes, ask for directions, navigate public transport, and master the past tense (perfekt) and cases.

b1.title: B1 · INTERMEDIATE
b1.desc: Hold natural conversations, express opinions, handle bureaucracy, and master future tense (futur prvi).

b2.title: B2 · UPPER INTERMEDIATE
b2.desc: Understand news broadcasts, debate topics, master all 7 Croatian cases (padeži), and read local media.

c1.title: C1 · ADVANCED
c1.desc: Express complex thoughts fluently, master Croatian idioms, literature, and formal professional communication.

c2.title: C2 · NATIVE MASTERY
c2.desc: Complete linguistic fluency, effortless humor comprehension, regional dialects, and academic excellence.

p2.title: SM-2 Spaced Repetition (SRS)

p3.title: Gamified XP & Daily Streaks

faq.title: EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO KNOW
faq.a1: Yes! All lessons, grammar explanations, SRS vocabulary flashcards, mini-games, and AI chat are 100% free with no paywalls or microtransactions.
faq.a2: Explanations and translations are fully localized in Ukrainian, Russian, and English for maximum comprehension.
faq.q3: How long does it take to reach B1 level?
faq.a3: With 15-20 minutes of daily practice using our structured lessons and AI roleplay, most learners reach B1 fluency within 4-6 months.
faq.q4: Do I need prior knowledge to start?
faq.a4: Not at all! Our A1 course starts from scratch—learning the Croatian alphabet, pronunciation rules, and essential greetings.
